symptom_en: Loss of ACARS communication in flight. The flight returned to LAX and an emergency was declared.
symptom_ko: 비행 중 ACARS 통신이 상실됨. 항공편이 LAX로 회항했고 비상선언이 이루어짐.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: FLIGHT AIR RETURNED TO LAX ON ACCOUNT OF LOSS OF ACARS COMMUNICATION. FLIGHT DECLARED EMERGENCY. MAINTENANCE REPLACED HF-1 XCVR IAW AMM 23-11-33, ALSO, REPLACED HF-2 COUPLER IAW AMM 23-11-36. HF-1 BITE AND OPS TEST NORMAL IAW AMM 23-11-00. REPLACED HF-2 COUPLER IAW AMM 23-11-36. HF-2 BITE AND OPS TEST NORMAL IAW AMM 23-11-00. (SEE SDR # AALA201911259053, AALA201911259054).

symptom_en: False overspeed warning in flight. The aircraft was in clean/flap up configuration when the warning occurred.
symptom_ko: 비행 중 오버스피드 경고가 잘못 발생함. 경고 발생 시 기체는 클린/플랩 업 상태였음.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: PILOT REPORTS FLIGHT RETURNED TO PHX ON ACCOUNT OF FALSE OVERSPEED WARNING. EMERGENCY DECLARED AND THE FLIGHT LANDED OVERWEIGHT WITHOUT INCIDENT. MAINTENANCE CONFIRMS THE AIRCRAFT WAS IN CLEAN/FLAP UP CONFIGURATION DURING THE OVERSPEED WARNING EVENTS. MAINTENANCE SUSPECTS THE FLAP HANDLE COMMAND SENSOR AT FAULT. REMOVED AND REPLACED THE FLAP CONTROL COMMAND SENSOR UNIT IAW AMM 27-51-17. OPS CHECK GOOD.

symptom_en: Managed speed would not hold steady in flight and varied continuously.
symptom_ko: 비행 중 관리 속도가 일정하게 유지되지 않고 계속 변동함.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: PILOT REPORTS AT FL 37.0 MANAGED SPEED AT .78, SPEED VAIRIES FROM .76. TO .79 CONTINUOUSLY IN SELECTED SPEED MAINTAIN .78. MAINTENANCE REPLACED FLIGHT CONTROL UNIT IAW AMM-22-81-12. OPS CHECKS GOOD.

symptom_en: Loss of ADIRU 1 and 3. Nose gear steering was lost and alternate landing gear extension was required.
symptom_ko: ADIRU 1과 3 상실. 노즈 기어 조향이 상실되어 대체 착륙장치 전개가 필요했음.
narrative_raw: SHIP 3240 - GEAR - DUE TO THE LOSS OF ADIRU-1 & 3. ADIRU-3 WAS ON MEL AND ADIRU-1 FAILED EN ROUTE. ALTERNATE LANDING GEAR EXTENSION WAS CARRIED OUT AND THE SHIP WAS TOWED TO THE GATE DUE TO THE LOSS OF NOSE GEAR STEERING. CORRECTIVE ACTION - REPLACED AIR DATA MODULE ADM-4 (19FP4) - RT STATIC PRESSURE

symptom_en: Dual FMGC failure in flight. All IRS lost position.
symptom_ko: 비행 중 FMGC 2대가 동시에 고장남. 모든 IRS가 위치를 상실함.
narrative_raw: FLT 783, EWR-STI.  DIVERTED TO SDQ.  DUAL FMGC FAILURE IN FLIGHT FMGC 2 RESET ATTEMPTED WITH NO LUCK.  ALL IRS LOST POSITION.  R & R FMGC 2, IAW AMM 22-83-34.  OPERATIONS CHECK GOOD.  FMGC 2 WAS REPLACED, PER TSI 428158 ON WO 109662.

symptom_en: Unable to transmit or receive on radio 2 or 3.
symptom_ko: 2번 또는 3번 무전기로 송수신이 되지 않음.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: UNABLE TO TRANSMIT OR RECIEVE ON #2 OR #3 RADIOS. **SUPPLEMENTAL ACTION SECT 4 AND 5: REPLACED AMU IAW AMM 23-51-34 #2 VHF COM OPS CHECK NORMAL. ALSO SEE AALA202003179012.

symptom_en: Left-side LTV from rows 18-29 was inoperative. A strong odor was noticed briefly before the TVs went out, and there was a burnt connector at row 22ABC.
symptom_ko: 좌측 18-29열 LTV가 작동하지 않음. TV가 꺼지기 전 잠깐 강한 냄새가 났고 22ABC열에서 탄 커넥터가 발견됨.
narrative_raw: FLT 516, SFO-JFK. LTV FROM ROWS 18-29 LEFT-SIDE  INOP. NOTE : FLIGHT ATTENDANTS NOTICED A STRONG ODOR FOR A SHORT TIME BEFORE TV’S WHEN OUT. TURNED OFF SYS AND ODOR DID NOT RETURN LTV SYSTEM REMAINED OFF; PERFORMED TSM 24-00-00-810-823-A. NO DEFECTS NOTED. LTV ELECTRICAL ODOR INTEGRITY CHECK REQUIRED. ACCOMPLISHED ELECTRICAL INTEGRITY CHECK FOR LTV SYSTEM IAW AMM 44-20-00. FOUND BURNT CONNECTOR AT ROW 22ABC. REFER TO LOG PAGE 2554840-1 FOR CORRECTIVE ACTION. R & R BURNT SEAT TO SEAT HARNESS AT ROW 22ABC TO 23ABC IAW AMM 44-20-21. REQUIRES SSBX TO CLEAR ITEM.

symptom_en: EPSU system test failed with an EPSU forward left class 1 fault.
symptom_ko: EPSU 시스템 테스트에서 EPSU 전방 좌측 클래스 1 고장이 발생함.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT NOT GROUNDED: MAINTENANCE REPORTS EPSU SYS TEST FAILS EPSU (10WL) FWD L CLASS 1 FAULT. RESET CIDS 1 AND ACCOMPLISHED BITE OF EPSU SYS TEST IAW AMM 33-51-00. OPS CHECK NORMAL. NO FAULTS NOTED IAW AMM 33-51-00.

symptom_en: Uncommanded PA and interphone activation after landing, with associated chimes. EMER EVAC HORN also came on intermittently.
symptom_ko: 착륙 후 지시되지 않은 PA와 인터폰 작동이 있었고 관련 차임이 울림. EMER EVAC HORN도 간헐적으로 울림.
narrative_raw: AFTER LANDING RECEIVED UNCOMMANDED PA AND INTERPHONE ACTIVATION WITH ASSOCIATED CHIMES. EMER EVAC HORN ALSO CAME ON INTERMITTENTLY. / REMOVED & REPLACED CIDS DIRECTOR IAW AMM 23-73-34. OPS CHECK GOOD NO DEFECTS NOTED."

symptom_en: Captains PFD and ND went blank during takeoff roll, and NAV IR 1 fault came on with ECAM action. IR 1 fault light blinked the entire flight.
symptom_ko: 이륙 활주 중 기장 PFD와 ND가 꺼졌고 NAV IR 1 고장과 ECAM 조치가 발생함. IR 1 고장등이 전 비행 동안 점멸함.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT NOT GROUNDED: PILOT REPORTS ON TAKEOFF ROLL AT APROX 120KTS, CAPTS PFD & ND WENT BLANK, ON CLIMB OUT. NAV IR 1 FAULT CAME ON ACCOMP ECAM ACTION. IR 1 FAULT LIGHT BLINKED ENTIRE FLIGHT. MAINTENANCE REPLACED #1 ADIRU IAW AMM 34-12-34-001. OPS CHECK NORMAL.1

symptom_en: After takeoff, AUTO FLT AUTO THRUST OFF message appeared and auto thrust could not be recovered after changing autopilots.
symptom_ko: 이륙 후 AUTO FLT AUTO THRUST OFF 메시지가 표시되었고 오토파일럿을 바꿔도 오토스로틀이 복구되지 않음.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT NOT GROUNDED. ECAM AFTER TAKE OFF "AUTO FLT AUTO THRUST OFF" WE WERE UNABLE TO RECOVER AUTO THRUST AFTER CHANGING AUTO PILOTS. ACCOMPLISHED AFS AND LAND TEST PER 22-30-00.

symptom_en: Intermittent autothrust ECAM messages and numerous ECAM warnings during rejected takeoff below 80 knots.
symptom_ko: 80노트 이하에서 이륙중단 중 오토스로틀 관련 ECAM 메시지가 간헐적으로 발생했고 여러 ECAM 경고가 연속으로 나타남.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: PILOT REPORTS ABORTED TAKEOFF BELOW 80 KNOTS FOR AUTOTHRUST INTERMITTENT ECAM TO BE FOLLOWED BY NUMEROUS ECAMS. MAINTENANCE REPLACED FLIGHT MANAGEMENT AND GUIDANCE COMPUTER NO. 2 IAW AMM 22-83-34. NO FAULTS NOTED. SATISFACTORY LAND CAT III CAPABILITY TEST ACCOMPLISHED IAW AMM 22-97-00, CARD 26L00022001.

symptom_en: Unreliable airspeed indication during takeoff.
symptom_ko: 이륙 중 속도 지시가 신뢰할 수 없었음.
narrative_raw: UNRELIABLE AIRSPEED INDICATION ON T/O. CAPT @ 70KTS, FO @ 105 ABORTED TAKE-OFF - MAX BRAKE TEMP WAS APPROX 720°. FLUSHED PITOT STATIC SYSTEM, PERFORMED FUNCTIONAL TEST OF ALT AIRSPEED DATA SYSTEM, FUNCTIONAL TEST PASSED IAW AMM 34-13-00-720-009-B.

symptom_en: Total radio contact was lost on approach. VHF 1, 2, and 3 would not work until short final.
symptom_ko: 접근 중 무선 연락이 완전히 끊김. 최종접근 직전까지 VHF 1, 2, 3이 작동하지 않았음.
narrative_raw: ON APPROACH INTO LGA WE LOST TOTAL RADIO CONTACT. VHF #1, #2 AND #3 WOULD NOT WORK. TRIED MULTIPLE FREQUENCIES. ON SHORT FINAL WE FINALLY WERE ABLE TO COMMUNICATE ON VHF 1 WITH TOWER, R/R NBR 1 RMP

symptom_en: IR 3 was inoperative for navigation.
symptom_ko: IR 3가 항법용으로 작동하지 않음.
narrative_raw: INERTIAL REFERENCE (IR) 3 INOP - NAV. REQUEST MEL 3410C. MEL APPROVED BY TOMC PER 3410C, DDP C/W. PLACARD INSTALLED ITEM PLACE ON MEL. SLAVED IN ADIRU 3 REF MM 34-12-34, NO HELP, ORIGINAL REINSTALLED.  REF WDM 34-11-03 REPLACED RELAY 16FP, NO HELP. IR3 TEST SHOWS ADIRU 3 DC SUPPLY FAULT DURING IR SYS TEST, NEEDS MORE T-S. REPLACED RELAY 14FP REF TSM 34-14-08-810-901-A, AND ASM 34-11-01. OPS CHECK GOOD.

symptom_en: Master caution came on and the thrust levers were not in detent during takeoff. A configuration warning occurred and the takeoff was rejected.
symptom_ko: 이륙 중 마스터 카션이 켜졌고 스러스트 레버가 디텐트에 있지 않았음. 구성 경고가 발생하여 이륙을 중단함.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT GROUNDED - MASTER CAUTION PLUS THRUST LEVERS NOT IN DETENT, THRUST SET AT FLEX, REJECTED TAKEOFF 59KTS.  CONFIGURATION WARNING, AIRCRAFT RECORDED NO SYSTEM FAULTS ON PFR (POST FLIGHT REPORT). ACCOMPLISHED GROUND SCAN OF CWS (CENTRAL WARNING SYSTEM) PER AMM 31-50-00, NO FAULTS NOTED, PASSED GROUND SCAN. ABORTED TAKE-OFF BELOW 80 KTS, NO INSPECTION REQUIRED PER GPM.

symptom_en: On approach, NAV and FINAL were not displayed on the FMA for the RNAV (GPS) approach, and the ILS showed the incorrect identifier and frequency, preventing localizer interception.
symptom_ko: 접근 중 RNAV (GPS) 접근에서 FMA에 NAV와 FINAL이 표시되지 않았고, ILS에 잘못된 식별자와 주파수가 표시되어 로컬라이저를 잡지 못했음.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: ON APPROACH MIA SELECTED RNAV (GPS) RWY 8L APPROACH NAV AND FINAL NOT DISPLAYED ON FMA.  FREQ 111.9 DISPLAYED ON PFD SELECTED ILS 8R INCORRECT IDENTIFIER, INCORRECT FREQ 111.9 DISPLAYED UNABLE TO INTERCEPT LOCALIZER.  THE APPROACH WAS ABORTED AND THE AIRCRAFT DIVERTED TO PBI, WHERE IT LANDED SAFELY WITHOUT FURTHER INCIDENT.  NO EMERGENCY WAS DECLARED.  RESET MMR1 AND 2, ACCOMPLISHED MMR BITE CHECK AND FAULT CLEARED, PER AMM 34-36-00.

symptom_en: Strong electrical odor in the flight deck. The lower ECAM display unit was inoperative.
symptom_ko: 조종실에서 강한 전기 타는 냄새가 남. 하부 ECAM 디스플레이 유닛이 작동하지 않음.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED.  STRONG ELECTRICAL ODOR IN FLIGHT DECK, DECLARED EMERGENCY AND DIVERTED TO LAS.  TROUBLESHOOTING DETERMINED LOWER ECAM DISPLAY UNIT INOPERABLE.  REPLACED LOWER ECAM DU, IAW AMM 31-63-22.  OPERATIONS CHECK GOOD.

symptom_en: Autothrottle went off in cruise.
symptom_ko: 순항 중 오토스로틀이 꺼짐.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT GROUNDED, [REPEAT ITEM] AUTOTHROTTLE OFF ECAM AT CRUISE, AUTOTHROTTLE RE-ENGAGED WITH A/P 2  PER QRH (QUICK REFERENCE HANDBOOK) PROCEDURE.  REMOVED AND REPLACED FLIGHT MANAGEMENT AND GUIDANCE COMPUTER (FMGC) 2, PER AMM 22-83-34, OPERATIONAL CHECK GOOD.  CLEARED MEL.

symptom_en: Weather radar was inoperative and WIFI/internet was not working. The flight diverted and landed overweight without incident.
symptom_ko: 기상 레이더가 작동하지 않았고 WIFI/인터넷도 작동하지 않음. 항공편이 우회 착륙했고 과중량 상태로 무사히 착륙함.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: PILOT DIVERTED ON ACCOUNT OF WEATHER RADAR INOPERATIVE AND WIFI/INTERNET WAS NOT WORKING. EMERGENCY DECLARED AND LANDED OVERWEIGHT WITHOUT INCIDENT. MAINTENANCE REMOVED AND REPLACED WX RADAR CONTROL PANEL IAW AMM 34-41-12. OPS CHECK GOOD.

symptom_en: XM antenna structural damage around an oversized existing doubler and edge distance condition. Located between FR 54 to FR 55 and between STR 1R to STR 1L.
symptom_ko: XM 안테나 구조물에 손상이 있고 기존 더블러가 과대하며 엣지 거리 조건 이상이 있음. 위치는 FR 54~55 사이, STR 1R~1L 사이임.
narrative_raw: DURING HMV, PERFORM REPAIR TO XM ANTENNA STRUCTURAL DEMOD/OVERSIZED EXISTING DOUBLER/EDGE DISTANCE CONDITION, PER EA AND THALES ENGINEERING AUTHORIZATION 3214 REV IR.  RESOLVED ON W/O: 1027857 TASKCARD: NR-00006, REF NR W/O 2020-193/1 WCC 2020-263358.  PERFORMED REPAIR TO XM ANTENNA STRUCTURAL DEMOD/OVERSIZED EXISTING DOUBLER/EDGE DISTANCE CONDITION, PER EA 53-0633-20 AND THALES ENGINEERING AUTHORIZATION 3214 REV IR.  FOR WORKSTEPS PERFORMED SEE EC A20-668-01 AE 2020 304280.  EXACT LOCATION IS BETWEEN FR 54 TO FR 55 AND BETWEEN STR 1R TO STR 1L.

symptom_en: Selected speed could not be controlled on the FCU; the speed could be pulled but not selected. Emergency declared.
symptom_ko: FCU에서 선택 속도를 제어할 수 없었고, 속도는 당길 수 있지만 선택할 수 없었음. 비상 선언됨.
narrative_raw: FT # 1006, LGB-SEA. EMERGENCY DECLARED. UNABLE TO CONTROL SELECTED SPEED ON FCU CAN PULL BUT NOT SELECT A SPEED TO FLY; REMOVED AND REPLACED FCU IAW AMM 22-81-12-000-001-A AND 22-81-12-400-001-A. PERFORMED OPS CHECK OF FCU IAW AMM 22-96-00-710-001-A. OPS CHECK GOOD.

symptom_en: Electronic and navigation fail message displayed. Flight returned to SFO.
symptom_ko: 전자 및 항법 고장 메시지가 표시됨. 항공기가 SFO로 회항함.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: FLIGHT AIR RETURNED TO SFO ON ACCOUNT OF ELECTRONIC AND NAVIGATION FAIL MESSAGE. NO EMERGENCY DECLARED. MAINTENANCE REPLACED #1 ADIRU IAW AMM 34-12-34. OPS CHECKS GOOD.

symptom_en: AP2 disconnected uncommanded during cruise. FMA showed 1 FD 1 and FO map showed offside FM control.
symptom_ko: 순항 중 AP2가 명령 없이 꺼짐. FMA에 1 FD 1이 표시되고 FO MAP에 offside FM control이 표시됨.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT NOT GROUNDED: PILOT REPORTS DURING CRUISE, AP2 OFF UNCOMMANDED. FMA SHOWS 1 FD 1 AND FO MAP HAS OFFSIDE FM CONTROL. MAINTENANCE RESET #2 FMGC C/BS IAW AMM 22-83-34. PERFORMED AFS TEST IAW AMM 22-96-00. ALL SYSTEMS GO.

symptom_en: Loss of ACARS communication. Emergency declared and flight returned to LAX.
symptom_ko: ACARS 통신이 상실됨. 비상 선언 후 항공기가 LAX로 회항함.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: FLIGHT AIR RETURNED TO LAX ON ACCOUNT OF LOSS OF ACARS COMMUNICATION. FLIGHT DECLARED EMERGENCY. MAINTENANCE REPLACED HF-1 XCVR IAW AMM 23-11-33, ALSO, REPLACED HF-2 COUPLER IAW AMM 23-11-36. HF-1 BITE AND OPS TEST NORMAL IAW AMM 23-11-00. REPLACED HF-2 COUPLER IAW AMM 23-11-36. HF-2 BITE AND OPS TEST NORMAL IAW AMM 23-11-00. (SEE SDR # AALA201911259019, AALA201911259054).

symptom_en: Cover slide for passenger crew door 842 was improperly packed in the passenger cabin.
symptom_ko: 승객 객실에서 passenger crew door 842의 커버 슬라이드가 제대로 포장되지 않았음.
narrative_raw: DURING HMV, INPROPERLY PACKED COVER SLIDE PASSENGER CREW DOOR 842 IN PASSENGER CABIN ; REF: ARM W/O 2020 80/1 N/R 2020-102453. R & R SLIDE IAW AMM 25-62-44-400-803.

symptom_en: Right aft lavatory door was difficult to open.
symptom_ko: 우측 후방 화장실 문이 열기 어려웠음.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS NOT GROUNDED: RIGHT AFT LAVATORY DOOR WAS DIFFICULT TO OPEN. MAINTENANCE ADJUSTED RIGHT AFT LAVATORY DOOR ASSEMBLY AND PERFORMED SATISFACTORY OPERATIONAL CHECK.

symptom_en: L1 passenger/crew door slide lock wire for the release cable retaining balls and pins is broken.
symptom_ko: L1 승객/승무원 도어 슬라이드의 릴리즈 케이블 고정 볼과 핀용 락 와이어가 끊어짐.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT IN BASE VISIT: L1 PASS/CREW/DOOR SLIDE, LOCK WIRE FOR RELEASE CABLE RETAINING BALLS AND PINS IS BROKEN. REPLACED THE L1 PASS/CREW/DOOR SLIDE IAW CARD #26C83152008.

symptom_en: O2 bottle has a damaged connector and is considered inoperative. New mask assembly needed; bottle is placarded.
symptom_ko: O2 실린더 커넥터가 손상되어 있고 작동하지 않는 것으로 간주됨. 새 마스크 어셈블리가 필요하며 실린더는 플래카드 부착됨.
narrative_raw: CREW REPORTS O2 BOTTLE HAS DAMAGED CONNECTOR UPDATED MAA CODE CRW USING VENDOR MAA SCREEN WORKING ITEM WITH CREW BOTTLE CONSIDERED INOP. NEEDS NEW MASK ASSY. BOTTLE IS IN PLACE AND PLACARDED. BOTTLE LOCATED AFT CABIN NOC DATE: 31-OCT-19- MEL APPROVED BOTTLE PLACRDED PER MEL R/R AFT GALLEY PORTABLE O2 BOTTLE IAW AMM 35-30-00 LEAK CHECK GOOD. NEW MASK INSTALLED.

symptom_en: Electric smell from the forward cabin lavatory, with no visible smoke. Isolated to the lavatory water heater thermostat overheating.
symptom_ko: 전방 객실 화장실에서 전기 타는 냄새가 났고 보이는 연기는 없었음. 화장실 온수기 온도조절기의 과열로 확인됨.
narrative_raw: DIV - DUE TO ELECTRIC SMELL COMING FROM F/C LAV NO VISIBLE SMOKE. ISOLATED TO OVERHEATING OF LAVATORY WATER HEATER THERMOSTAT. CORRECTIVE ACTION: DEFERRED WATER HEATER TO MEL AND LOCKED OUT FWD LAVATORY. (10/8 ATL) REPLACED HOT WATER HEATER AND THERMOSTAT. (10/9 ATL) INSTALLED NEW O-RINGS AT HOT WATER HEATER. NO LEAKS AND NO BURNING SMELL, ALL WORK PERFORMED PER AMM 38-12.

symptom_en: Brown smelly fluid ran from under the lavatory bulkhead under the forward flight attendant jumpseat in front of the forward left door.
symptom_ko: 전방 좌측 도어 앞 전방 승무원 점프시트 아래 화장실 벌크헤드 밑에서 갈색의 악취 나는 액체가 흘러나옴.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: UPON TAKE OFF, BROWN SMELLY FLUID RAN FROM UNDER LAV BULKHEAD UNDER FWD F/A JUMPSEAT IN FRONT OF FWD LEFT DOOR. MAINTENANCE REMOVED AND REPLACED TOILET ASSEMBLY IAW AMM 38-31-41. OPS CHECK OK. LEAK CHECK OK.

symptom_en: Smell of gasoline in the last 3 rows and aft galley during cruise.
symptom_ko: 순항 중 뒤쪽 3개 좌석 줄과 후방 갤리에서 휘발유 냄새가 남.
narrative_raw: FA REPORTS SMELL OF GASOLINE IN LAST 3 ROWS AND AFT GALLEY DURING CRUISE FLIGHT AT FL250-FOUND AFT GALLEY PLATE DIRTY IAW TSM 05-50-00-810-831-A CLEANED AS NECESSARY AND OP CK IAW AMM 25-35-00. OP CK GOOD

symptom_en: LH aft overwing emergency exit hatch was blocked by a passenger seat backrest. All 4 emergency exit hatches were disarmed.
symptom_ko: 좌측 후방 날개 위 비상 탈출 해치가 승객 좌석 등받이에 막혀 있었음. 4개의 비상 탈출 해치가 모두 해제 상태였음.
narrative_raw:
DURING OPENING OF THE LH AFT OVERWING EMERGENCY EXIT HATCH, FOUND THE HATCH BLOCKED BY A PASSENGER SEAT BACKREST.
ONLY WHEN FORCING THE BACKREST FORWARD IT IS POSSIBLE TO REMOVE THE EXIT HATCH.
ALSO FOUND ALL 4 EMERGENCY EXIT HATCHES DISARMED, ALTHOUGH IT IS NOT CERTAIN IF THE AIRCRAFT ARRIVED IN THIS CONFIGURATION.

symptom_en: Corrosion found on the aft cargo roller tray.
symptom_ko: 후방 화물 롤러 트레이에 부식이 발견됨.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT IN BASE VISIT.  CORROSION ON AFT CARGO ROLLER TRAY, (FOUND AFTER REMOVAL OF CORRODED SCREWS) AT FR48 TO FR51, STR 38R AND BL Y-623.  REPLACED ROLLER TRACK ASSEMBLY IAW 51-20-01-1.

symptom_en: R4 and L4 doors needed servicing.
symptom_ko: R4 및 L4 도어에 정비가 필요했음.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS NOT GROUNDED: R4 AND L4 DOOR NEEDED SERVICING. MAINTENANCE SERVICED R4 AND L4.  DOOR ASSIST TO PROPER PRESSURE PER AMM 52-12-01.

symptom_en: Corrosion at the electrical connector of the aft door 832 slide pack.
symptom_ko: 후방 도어 832 슬라이드 팩의 전기 커넥터에 부식이 있음.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT IN BASE MAINTENANCE - CORROSION, ELECTRICAL CONNECTOR, AFT DOOR 832 SLIDE PACK.  REPLACED L2 DOOR (832) SLIDE PER AMM TASK 25-62-44-000-002-A, JOB CARD 26C83252008.

symptom_en: Seat 22DEF did not open the PSU oxygen panel.
symptom_ko: 22DEF 좌석에서 PSU 산소 패널이 열리지 않았음.
narrative_raw: DURING TEST FOUND SEAT 22DEF DID NOT OPEN PSU OXY PANEL.  CORRECTIVE ACTION: REPACKED PSU PANEL 22DEF, PER A320 AMM 35-21.  PERFORMED OPERATIONS CHECK, PER A320 AMM 35-23.  OPERATIONS CHECK GOOD.

symptom_en: Life raft above row 11ABC had lacing undone.
symptom_ko: 11ABC 열 위의 구명뗏목 레이싱이 풀려 있었음.
narrative_raw: FLT  283,  LIFE RAFT ABOVE ROW 11ABC FOUND LACING UNDONE; R & R LIFE RAFT ABOCE 11ABC AS PER AMM 25-66-41.

symptom_en: 1L door slide fails EPSU check out.
symptom_ko: 1L 도어 슬라이드가 EPSU 점검에서 실패함.
narrative_raw: 1L DOOR SLIDE FAILS EPSU CHECK OUT, REPLACED SLIDE RAFT

symptom_en: Emergency declared. In cruise, uncommanded O2 flow came from the First Officer's mask at an excessive rate, and the blinker lights activated on all other masks.
symptom_ko: 비상 선언됨. 순항 중 1번 부조종사 마스크에서 명령되지 않은 산소 유량이 과도하게 발생했고, 다른 모든 마스크의 블링커 라이트가 점등됨.
narrative_raw: (EMERGENCY DECLARED) IN CRUISE RECEIVED UNCOMMANDED O2 FLOW FROM FIRST OFFICERS MASK AT EXCESSIVE RATE. BLINKER LIGHTS ACTIVATED ON ALL OTHER MASKS O2 DEPLETED / REMOVED AND REPLACED PRESSURE REGULATOR"

symptom_en: Strong sewer-type smell reported primarily in the mid lav area from takeoff to touchdown. Cabin crew noted no change with different PACK configurations, and pilots did not smell the odor.
symptom_ko: 중간 화장실 구역에서 강한 하수구 같은 냄새가 발생함. 이륙부터 착륙까지 냄새가 지속되었고 PACK 구성 변경에도 변화가 없었으며, 조종사는 냄새를 맡지 못함.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: F/A REPORTED STRONG SEWER TYPE SMELL PRIMARILY MID LAV AREA. SMELL STARTED FROM T/O TO T/D DIFFERENT PACK CONFIGS NO CHANGES ENROUTE NOTED BY F/A. PILOTS NEVER SMELLED ANY ODOR. FLIGHT DIVERTED TO DFW. INSTALLED NEW MID LAV TOILET ASSEMBLY IAW AMM 38-31-41. OPS CHECK AND LEAK CHECK GOOD.

symptom_en: Forward galley oven #2 had an electrical smell while in use and tended to overheat.
symptom_ko: 전방 갤리 오븐 #2 사용 중 전기 타는 냄새가 나고 과열되는 경향이 있음.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS NOT GROUNDED: FORWARD GALLEY OVEN #2 HAS ELECTRICAL SMELL WHILE IN USE. TENTS TO OVER HEAT. ***SUPPLEMENTAL ACTION SECTION 4 AND 5: REMOVED AND REPLACED FWD GALLEY OVEN #2 IAW AMM 25-35-19.***(CLOSED)

symptom_en: PSU at seats 16DEF was inoperative when the O2 masks were deployed.
symptom_ko: 16DEF 좌석의 PSU가 산소 마스크 전개 시 작동하지 않음.
narrative_raw: (AIRCRAFT 3115, L/P 1540063) PSU AT SEATS 16DEF WERE INOP WHEN O2 MASKS WERE DEPLOYED. REMOVED PSU AND SEND TO ATL. CORRECTIVE ACTION: REMOVED PSU AT SEAT 16DEF INSTALLED SERVICEABLE PSU PER A319 AMM 35-21-41.

symptom_en: Corrosion found on the aft cargo compartment left-hand sidewall cargo net tie-down fitting at FR 51 and S38L.
symptom_ko: 후방 화물칸 좌측 측벽의 화물망 고정 브래킷에 부식이 발견됨. 위치는 FR 51 및 S38L임.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT IN BASE MAINTENANCE: CORROSION ON AFT CARGO COMPARTMENT LEFT HAND SIDEWALL CARGO NET TIE DOWN FITTING AT FR 51 AND S38L. REPLACED TIE DOWN FITTING PER SRM 51-42-11.

symptom_en: Left emergency door assist bottle charge was low.
symptom_ko: 좌측 비상문 보조 병의 충전량이 낮음.
narrative_raw: LEFT EMERGENCY DOOR ASSIST BOTTLE CHARGE LOW.  SERVICED THE DOOR ASSIST BOTTLE IAW AMM 52-10-00. LEAK CHECK GOOD.

symptom_en: The O2 masks at seats 1AB and 2AB did not deploy during a manual drop test.
symptom_ko: 1AB 및 2AB 좌석의 산소 마스크가 수동 드롭 테스트에서 전개되지 않음.
narrative_raw: (AIRCRAFT 3115, L/P 1528579) SEAT 1 AB AND 2 AB 02 MASKS DID NOT DEPLOY ON MANUAL DROP TEST. CORRECTIVE ACTION: REMOVED AND REPLACED SEATS 1 AB AND 2 AB 02 PANEL REF A319 AMM 35-21-41. TRANSFERRED 02 GEN TO NEW PANELS.

symptom_en: Slide raft in the forward galley area was deformed.
symptom_ko: 전방 갤리 구역의 슬라이드 래프트가 변형됨.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT IN BASE MAINTENANCE - FORWARD GALLEY AREA SLIDE RAFT DEFORMED.  REPLACED SLIDE RAFT PASSENGER CREW DOOR 831 AT FORWARD GALLEY AREA  PER AMM 25-62-44-400-007-A.

symptom_en: Emergency light test failed during service check. The aft left slide light fault remained when the slide lights were disconnected.
symptom_ko: 정비 점검 중 비상등 테스트가 실패함. 슬라이드 조명을 분리했을 때도 후방 좌측 슬라이드 조명 고장이 남아 있음.
narrative_raw: EMERGENCY LIGHT TEST FAILED DURING SVC CHECK. ESCAPE SLIDE LIGHTING. FOUND THAT ALL FAULTS CLEARED EXCEPT AFT LT SLIDE WHEN SLIDE LIGHTS WERE DISCONNECTED. T/S PER A321 TSM 33-51-00-810-839A. REMOVED L4 DOOR PER CARD 2561-4003-LA. WHILE PREPARING NEW SLIDE FOR INSTALL FOUND IT TO BE BAD FROM STOCK. NO SLIDES AVAILABLE IN ATL.(069188) NEW SLIDE INSTALLED AT AFT LT DOOR PER CARD 2561-4003-LA. EMER. LT CK GOOD.

symptom_en: Low crew oxygen reported en route, with bottle pressure at 380 psi.
symptom_ko: 비행 중 승무원 산소량 부족이 보고되었고, 병 압력은 380 psi였음.
narrative_raw: DIVERTED DUE TO LOW CREW O2. 380 PSI EN-ROUTE.  FOUND LOOSE B NUT AT THE O2 BOTTLE PRESSURE REGULATOR. SECURED THE LINE AND SERVICED THE O2 BOTTLE.

symptom_en: Strong urine odor reported around the left mid-cabin lavatory next to door 3L, with wet carpet near F/A jumpseat #4. Crew also reported a noise like something falling from the lavatory floor area on takeoff.
symptom_ko: 왼쪽 중간 객실 화장실, 3L 도어 옆에서 강한 소변 냄새가 나고 F/A 점프시트 #4 근처 카펫이 젖어 있음. 이륙 시 화장실 바닥 쪽에서 무언가 떨어지는 듯한 소리도 보고됨.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: PILOT REPORTS STRONG URINE ODER IN VICINITY OF LAVATORY L., MID CABIN NEXT TO DOOR 3L. CARPET WET NEAR F/A JUMPSEAT NO.4. F/A REPORTED REPORTED NOISE LIKE SOMETHING FALLING FROM FLOOR AREA OF LAV ON TAKE OFF. REMOVED AND REPLACED MID LAV L TOILET IAW AMM 38-31-41. OPS CHECK GOOD.

symptom_en: Chafing found on the upper forward pylon integrated drive generator electrical cable on the right pylon, outboard side rib 06.
symptom_ko: 우측 파일런 외측 리브 06의 상부 전방 파일런 통합 구동 발전기 전기 케이블에 마모가 발견됨.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT IN BASE MAINTENANCE.  CHAFING UPPER FORWARD PYLON INTEGRATED DRIVE GENERATOR ELECTRICAL CABLE, OUTBOARD SIDE RIB 06 ON RT PYLON.  REPLACED UPPER FORWARD PYLON INTEGRATED DRIVE GENERATOR ELECTRICAL CABLE PER AMM 24-92-00-400-002A AND ESPM 20-44-52 AND PERFORMED OPERATIONAL TEST, TEST GOOD.

symptom_en: Cockpit instrument panel light plates 301VU and 500VU were burned.
symptom_ko: 조종실 계기판의 라이트 플레이트 301VU와 500VU가 타서 손상됨.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT IN BASE MAINTENANCE - COCKPIT INSTRUMENT PANEL, LIGHT PLATE 301VU AND 500VU BURNED. REPLACED INTEGRALLY LIGHTED PLATE 500VU IN COCKPIT AREA PER AMM 33-13-43-400-802-A. PERFORMED OPERATIONAL TEST OF INSTRUMENT AND PANEL INTEGRAL LIGHTING PLATE PER AMM 33-13-00-710-001-A, TESTED OK. [SEE ASSOCIATED REPORT AALA202004029010]

symptom_en: On the takeoff roll, ECAM ELEC IDG1 OIL LOW PRESS message appeared and the takeoff was rejected at 60 knots.
symptom_ko: 이륙 활주 중 ECAM ELEC IDG1 OIL LOW PRESS 메시지가 표시되었고 60노트에서 이륙이 중단됨.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: PILOT REPORTS ON TAKE OFF ROLL, ECAM ELEC IDG1 OIL LOW PRESS. REJECTED TAKE-OFF AT 60 KTS. MAINTENANCE REMOVED AND REPLACED ENG #1 IDG IAW AMM 24-21-51-000-040-B, 24-21-51-400-040-B. OPS CHECK OK.

symptom_en: Aft inboard lavatory auxiliary light above the door was inoperative.
symptom_ko: 후방 내측 화장실 문 위 보조등이 작동하지 않음.
narrative_raw: AFT INBOARD LAVATORY AUXILIARY LIGHT ABOVE DOOR INOPERATIVE. FOUND 28VDC INTERMITTENT AT TERMINAL BLOCK 7201VT-9. OPERATION CHECKS GOOD.

symptom_en: Emergency generation would not test, with no frequency and no voltage.
symptom_ko: 비상 발전이 테스트되지 않으며 주파수와 전압이 없음.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: MAINTENANCE REPORTS EMERGENCY GENERATION WILL NOT TEST (NO FREQ, NO VOLT). REMOVED AND REPLACED AC ESSENTIAL BUS SWITCHING CONTACTOR (3XC) IAW AMM 24-25-55. OPS CHECK GOOD.

symptom_en: Emergency battery capacity test failed on batteries 10WL, 11WL, 12WL, 14WL, and 15WL.
symptom_ko: 비상 배터리 용량 테스트에서 10WL, 11WL, 12WL, 14WL, 15WL 배터리가 실패함.
narrative_raw: FT # 834, SFO-BOS. PERFORMED TASK CARD A320-33-51-00-710-003.(CHECK THE BATTERY CAPACITY) 10WL, 15WL, 11WL, 14WL, AND 12WL FAIL TEST; REF LP 2789771-1. ALSO REPLACED 11WL AND 12WL WITH OPS CK GOOD PER AMM 33-51-38. REMOVED AND REPLACED EMERGENCY BATTERY (10WL) PER AMM 33-51-38. REPLACED EMERGENCY BATTERIES 14WL AND 15WL PER AMM 33-51-38. OPS CHECK GOOD.

symptom_en: Operational test of the door switch power supplies with emergency exit light switch 4WL failed when circuit breakers 13WN (P10) and 15WN (P11) were open on door 834.
symptom_ko: 도어 834에서 차단기 13WN(P10)과 15WN(P11)을 열었을 때 비상 출구등 스위치 4WL와 함께 도어 스위치 전원 공급 장치 운용 테스트가 실패함.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT IN BASE MAINTENANCE.  DID NOT PASS OPERATIONAL TEST DOOR SWITCH POWER SUPPLIES WITH EMERGENCY EXIT LIGHT SWITCH (4WL) WHEN CIRCUIT BREAKERS 13WN (P10) AND 15WN( P11) ARE OPEN ON DOOR 834.  PERFORMED CLEANING IN THE CONNECTORS PROXIMITY SWITCHES 61WV1, 21WV1 AND 6WN.

symptom_en: During emergency generator test, ECAM message ELEC AC ESS BUS FAULT appeared.
symptom_ko: 비상 발전기 테스트 중 ECAM 메시지 ELEC AC ESS BUS FAULT가 표시됨.
narrative_raw: ETOPS SIGNIFICANT SYSTEM - DURING EMER GEN TEST ECAM MESSAGE ELEC AC ESS BUS FAULT ON ECAM.  FOLLOWED TSM 24-50-00-810-804-A. RELAY 12XE REPLACED AS REQUIRED. OPS CHECKS GOOD. OK FOR SVC.

symptom_en: Takeoff light was missing.
symptom_ko: 이륙등이 없어짐.
narrative_raw: PDA PART DEPARTED AIRCRAFT. A/C 3162 CLOSED LOG 6202563. REF. LOGPAGE 6202562. TAKE OFF LIGHT MISSING. REF LOG ITEM 6202562. REINSTALLED TAKEOFF LIGHT ASSY. INSTALLED NEW TAKE OFF LAMP AND NEW CLAMP ASSY. REVS -M- PROCEDURES. TAKE OFF LIGHT ASSY OPS NML.

symptom_en: Smoke and fumes were reported in the cabin, with electrical burning smell and no power to DC1. The cabin sidewall overhead lights between seat rows 1 through 15 left and 16 through 27 right were out and had a burned odor.
symptom_ko: 객실에 연기와 가스가 발생했고 전기 타는 냄새가 나며 DC1에 전원이 없음. 좌측 1~15열과 우측 16~27열 사이의 객실 측벽 오버헤드 조명이 꺼져 있고 탄 냄새가 남.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED.  SMOKE FUMES IN CABIN & GROUND POWER SHOWS 460HZ ON ELECTRICAL PAGE.  SMELLED ELECTRICAL BURNING ALONG WITH NO POWER TO DC1. REPLACED BUSS TIE RELAY 30XU1, NR 1 DC BUSS CONTACTOR 1PC1 IAW AMM 24-35-55.  CABIN SIDE WALL OVERHEAD LIGHTS BETWEEN SEAT ROWS 1 THRU 15 LEFT AND 16 THRU 27 RIGHT WERE OUT AND HAD A BURNED ODOR.  REPLACED MULTIPLE SIDEWALL LIGHT BALLASTS IAW AMM 33-21-11.

symptom_en: During descent at idle thrust, #2 IDG oil temp flashed amber at 190 C and returned to the green range when thrust was advanced.
symptom_ko: 하강 중 아이들 스러스트에서 2번 IDG 오일 온도가 190C에서 amber로 깜박였고, 스러스트를 올리면 녹색 범위로 돌아옴.
narrative_raw: DURING DECENT THRUST IS AT IDLE APU : #2 IDG OIL TEMP FLASHES AMBER AT 190 C WHEN TRUST ADVANCE TEMP BACK TO GREEN RANGE  GROUNDED - YES. R & R #2 IDG IAW AMM 24-21-51 PB 401 OPS CHK GOOD - NO LEAKS NOTED A/C RELEASED FROM MEL 24-20-01 - MDDR 73029 REMOVED MAINT PROC REVERSED , LOG UPDATED , PLACAR REMOVED, MCC NOTIFIED

symptom_en: During descent from FL180 until landing, a cabin odor was noticed, more noticeable in the flight deck, and it continued after landing.
symptom_ko: FL180 하강 중부터 착륙까지 객실 냄새가 났고, 조종실에서 더 심하게 느껴졌으며 착륙 후에도 지속됨.
narrative_raw: DURING DESCENT, FROM FL 180 UNTILL LANDING,  ENCOUNTERED A CABIN ODOR MORE NOTICEABLE IN THE FLIGHT DECK AND IT CONTINUED AFTER LANDING.  THE AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED.  ACCOMPLISHED WORKCARD 26L0021001 & 26L0021002 WITH NO ODOR NOTED IN FLIGHT DECK OR CABIN.   MAINTENANCE FOUND AN ELECTRICAL ODOR IN FWD E&E BAY, BULBS WERE FOUND TO BE BURNED,  REPLACED THE BULBS,  RAN ENGINES AND PACKS WITH NO ADDITIONAL ODORS FOUND.

symptom_en: An acrid electrical smell was noted in the cabin, starting about three quarters of the way aft and getting worse farther aft.
symptom_ko: 기내에서 매캐한 전기 냄새가 났고, 뒤쪽으로 갈수록 더 심해짐.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: UPON BOARDING AIRCRAFT, NOTED ACRID ELECTRICAL SMELL APPROX THREE QUARTERS OF THE WAY BACK IN  THE CABIN, THE SMELL GETS WORSE THE FURTHER AFT ONE GOES. MAINTENANCE FOUND 11 C POWER PORT DEFECTIVE. REMOVED AND REPLACED POWER PORT 11 C IAW AMM 44-22-00.

symptom_en: The megaphone was removed for troubleshooting.
symptom_ko: 메가폰을 점검을 위해 분리함.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS NOT GROUNDED: REMOVED MEGAPHONE FOR TROUBLESHOOTING. MAINTENANCE INSTALLED SAME MEGAPHONE WITH NEW BATTERIES REPLACED BY STANDARD MAINTENANCE PRACTICES.

symptom_en: Seat 19C emergency light was found inoperative on walk-around.
symptom_ko: 19C 좌석 비상등이 워크어라운드 중 작동하지 않음.
narrative_raw: FLT 766, GCM-JFK. SEAT 19C EMERGENCY LIGHT FOUND INOP ON WALK AROUND; FOUND SEAT 19C EMERGENCY LIGHT CONNECTOR DISCONNECTED. RECONNECTED EMERGENCY LIGHT CONNECTOR AND OPS OK PER AMM 33-51-00.

symptom_en: Chafing was found on electrical wiring IDG feeder cables in the right pylon.
symptom_ko: 오른쪽 파일런의 IDG 피더 케이블 전기 배선에 마찰 흔적이 발견됨.
narrative_raw: BASE MAINTENANCE, CHAFING ELECTRICAL WIRING IDG FEEDER CABLES 2422-4516C, 2422-4518, 2422-4517C, RT PYLON (3 EA).  REPLACED ELECTRICAL WIRING IDG FEEDER CABLES (3 EA), RIGHT PYLON, PER AWM 24-22-02 AMM TASK 24-92-00-400-002-A ESPM 20-44-52-0101-01.  PERFORMED SATISFACTORY CHECK ELEC PAGE FOR DIGITAL PARAMETERS.

symptom_en: During takeoff, a #2 IDG oil low pressure fault occurred and the takeoff was rejected at 90 knots.
symptom_ko: 이륙 중 2번 IDG 오일 저압 고장이 발생하여 90노트에서 이륙을 중단함.
narrative_raw: DURING TAKEOFF, RECEIVED A NR 2 IDG OIL LOW PRESSURE FAULT.  REJECTED TAKE OFF AT 90 KNOTS. RETURNED TO GATE. THE AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED.  REPLACED THE NR 2 ENGINE INTEGRATED DRIVE GENERATOR IAW AMM 24-21-51. OPS AND LEAK CHECKED GOOD.

symptom_en: Smoke and fumes were present in the cabin, with an electrical burning smell, no power to DC1, and ground power showing 460 Hz on the electrical page. Several sidewall lights were out and had a burned odor.
symptom_ko: 객실에 연기와 가스가 있었고 전기 타는 냄새가 났으며 DC1 전원이 없고 전기 페이지에 지상전원이 460Hz로 표시됨. 여러 측벽 조명이 꺼져 있었고 타는 냄새가 남.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: SMOKE FUMES IN CABIN & GROUND POWER SHOWS 460HZ ON ELECTRICAL PAGE. SMELLED ELECTRICAL BURNING ALONG WITH NO POWER TO DC1. REPLACED BUSS TIE RELAY 30XU1, NR 1 DC BUSS CONTACTOR 1PC1 IAW AMM 24-35-55. CABIN SIDE WALL OVERHEAD LIGHTS BETWEEN SEAT ROWS 1 THRU 15 LEFT AND 16 THRU 27 RIGHT WERE OUT AND HAD A BURNED ODOR.  REPLACED MULTIPLE SIDEWALL LIGHT BALLASTS IAW AMM 33-21-11.

symptom_en: The emergency light at 34C was broken.
symptom_ko: 34C 비상등이 파손됨.
narrative_raw: 34C EMERGENCY LIGHT BROKEN, INSTALLED SERVICEABLE EMERGENCY PATH LIGHT AT 34C.

symptom_en: The emergency light at seat 14C was inoperative.
symptom_ko: 14C 좌석 비상등이 작동하지 않음.
narrative_raw: EMERGENCY LIGHT AT SEAT 14C WAS INOPERATIVE.  SECURED A LOOSE CONNECTOR IAW AMM 33-51-00, AND PERFORMED A SATISFACTORY OPERATIONAL CHECK.

symptom_en: Chafing was found on wiring at the fan case on engine 2, at the 5 o'clock position.
symptom_ko: 2번 엔진 팬 케이스 5시 방향 배선에 마찰이 발견됨.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT IN BASE MAINTENANCE - CHAFING WIRING FAN CASE AT 5 OCLOCK ON ENGINE 2. REPAIRED IDG POWER FEEDER HARNESS 4210KS ON ENGINE 2 IAW ESPM 20-53-21 PB0202 CONFIG 1 AND ESPM 20-53-29.

symptom_en: During takeoff, IDG 2 oil pressure was low and generator 2 fault messages were displayed.
symptom_ko: 이륙 중 2번 IDG 오일 압력이 낮고 2번 발전기 고장 메시지가 표시됨.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: REJECTED TAKEOFF DUE TO IDG 2 OIL PRESSURE LOW AND GENERATOR 2 FAULT MESSAGES, IDG 2 APPROVED FOR DEFERRAL IAW MEL 24-01B. IDG 2 REPLACED WITH NEW IAW AMM 24-21-51-400-010-C, OPS CHECK GOOD.

symptom_en: The 2R exit row door overhead light was inoperative.
symptom_ko: 2R 출구열 도어 상부 조명이 작동하지 않음.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS NOT GROUNDED: 2R EXIT ROW DOOR OVERHEAD LIGHT INOPERATIVE. MAINTENANCE REPLACED LIGHT PER AMM 33-21-11.

symptom_en: Emergency exit lights were inoperative; on power failure they illuminated for 5 seconds and then failed.
symptom_ko: 비상탈출등이 작동하지 않음. 전원 차단 시 5초간 켜졌다가 꺼짐.
narrative_raw: FT # 1054, EMERGENCY EXIT LIGHTS INOP. ON POWER FAILURE ILLUMINATED FOR 5 SECONDS AND FAILED; R & R ALL EPSU BATTERIES PER AMM 33-51-38.

symptom_en: The aft left emergency slide light test failed, and the exterior lights failed as well.
symptom_ko: 후방 좌측 비상 슬라이드 조명 시험이 실패했고 외부 조명도 실패함.
narrative_raw: EPSU TEST FAILS 13WL AFT LT EMERGENCY SLIDE LT.  PERFORMED TSM 25-62-00-810-819-A REMOVED AND REPLACED 13WL ESPU AND FAILS EXTERIOR LIGHTS.  CONTINUED TROUBLESHOOTING AND FOUND CONNECTER UNDER SLIDE COVER AT L2 DOOR SLIDE DISCONNECTED.  RECONNECTED SLIDE WIRE HARNESS AND EPSU TEST OK, REF AMM 33-51-38 PB 401.

symptom_en: Engine 2 HP tip control fault message opened, then closed during climb.
symptom_ko: 상승 중 2번 엔진 HP 팁 제어 고장 메시지가 떴다가 사라짐.
narrative_raw: ENGINE 2 HP TIP CTL FAULT MESSAGE OPENED, THEN CLOSED ON CLIMB. GROUNDED - YES. PERFORMED TSM TASK 75-31-00-710-081-A STEPS 4.B (1) (A) (B) (C) AND 4.B (2) (A) (B) (C), CLEANED BOTH RECETACLES. NO HELP. VERIFIED FAULT, RELEASED PER MEL 75-21-01, ACCOMPLISHED MAINT PROCEDURES HPTACC VALVE LOCKED CLOSED. MEL LOG UPDATED. PLACARD INSTALLED. SEAMC AUTHORIZED.

symptom_en: Chafing was found on the wiring harness in the forward upper position of the number 2 engine fan case.
symptom_ko: 2번 엔진 팬 케이스 전방 상부 위치의 배선 하니스에 마찰이 발견됨.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT IN BASE MAINTENANCE - CHAFING WIRE (CONNECTOR 4012VCA) HARNESS, NR 2 ENGINE FAN CASE, FORWARD UPPER POSITION.  REPAIRED WIRING, AND PROPERLY ROUTED HARNESS IN NR 2 ENGINE FAN CASE FORWARD UPPER POSITION PER AMM TASK 70-71-22-0001-13.

symptom_en: A dirty sock smell was noticed on descent with idle thrust.
symptom_ko: 하강 중 아이들 스러스트에서 더러운 양말 같은 냄새가 남.
narrative_raw: DIRTY SOCK SMELL ON DESCENT INTO BWI  AT 6,000' WITH IDLE THRUST-PERFORM TSM 05-50-00-810-831-A FOUND OIL RESIDUE BEHIND ENG #1 SPINNER CLEAN AREA IAW AMM 72-11-01 PERF. ENG. RUN-UP PACK #1 AND #2 ORDER CANNOT DUPLICATED A/C GOOD FOR SVC.

symptom_en: The left engine was erratic, increasing and decreasing, with the aircraft yawing and engine indications climbing through 11,000 feet.
symptom_ko: 좌측 엔진 출력이 불규칙하게 증가와 감소를 반복했고, 항공기가 요잉했으며 11,000피트까지 엔진 지시값이 상승함.
narrative_raw: FT # 2006,  AIRCRAFT LEFT ENGINE-ERRATIC INCREASE AND DECREASE. FELT AIRCRAFT YAWING AND OBSERVED ENGINE INDICATIONS CLIMBING THROUGH 11,000 FEET; PERFORMED DFDR DATA DOWNLOAD AND READOUT ALL T/S DATA POINTS TO ENGINE 1 N1 SENSOR FAILED ENGINE 1 REMOVED AND REPLACED  REF W/O 976135 LOGPAGE 2483976 ITEM 1.

symptom_en: Engine 1 IGN B fault occurred.
symptom_ko: 1번 엔진 IGN B 고장이 발생함.
narrative_raw: ENGINE 1 IGN B FAULT GROUNDED - YES. PERFORMED TSM 74-21-00-810-809-A. NO FAULT FOUND. NO FAULT FOUND FOR LAST THREE FLIGHT LEGS ALT REF TO TBN-7400-00 FOR SPECIFICATIONS AT MAINT PROCEDURES REVERSED MEL 75512 IS CLEARED PLACARD REMOVED LIST UPDATED MCC LESTER IN O

symptom_en: No. 2 EEC incorrectly indicated a stall. The PB sense line was checked for leaks and held pressure with no leaks noted.
symptom_ko: 2번 EEC가 스톨을 잘못 표시함. PB 센스 라인을 누설 점검했으나 누설은 없었고 15분간 압력을 유지함.
narrative_raw: NR 2 EEC INCORECT REPORTING OF STALL.   PB SENSE LINE WAS PRESSURE CHECKED FOR LEAKS,  NO LEAKS NOTED,  LINE HELD PRESSURE FOR 15 MINUTES.

symptom_en: Corrosion was found on the lip skin between the 3 and 9 o'clock positions on engine 1.
symptom_ko: 1번 엔진의 3시와 9시 방향 사이 립 스킨에 부식이 확인됨.
narrative_raw: CORROSION LIP SKIN BTW 3 AND 9 O CLOCK ON ENGINE 1. REPLACED THE AIR INTAKE COWL ON ENG #1 ASPER A320 FAM AMM.

symptom_en: Engine 2 EGT overtemperature warning occurred during takeoff roll near 60 knots, and the takeoff was rejected. EGT stayed in the red for some time.
symptom_ko: 이륙 활주 중 약 60노트에서 2번 엔진 EGT 과온 경고가 발생하여 이륙을 중단함. EGT가 한동안 적색 구간에 머물렀음.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: ENGINE 2 EXHAUST GAS TEMPERATURE OVER LIMIT WARNING ON TAKEOFF ROLL NEAR 60 KNOTS, REJECTED TAKEOFF. EXHAUST GAS TEMPERATURE REMAINED IN RED FOR SOME TIME, DATA SHOWED EXHAUST GAS TEMPERATURE WAS 666 DEGREES FOR 60 SECONDS. ENGINE ANTI ICE WAS ON. MAINTENANCE FOUND 10TH STAGE HPC SOLENOID VALVE BAD. MAINTENANCE REPLACED VALVE PER AMM 75-32-53. MAINTENANCE ALSO REPLACED EXHAUST GAS TEMPERATURE HARNESS (SEE AALA201902059023) AND PROBES PER AARD 77-21-43-1 AND AMM 77-21-43. MAINTENANCE ALSO PERFORMED SATISFACTORY OPERATIONAL CHECK.

symptom_en: At engine shutdown at the gate, ENG 1 ONE TLA FAULT and ENG 1 REV MINOR FAULT ECAM messages appeared. No message remained on the ground.
symptom_ko: 게이트에서 엔진 셧다운 시 ENG 1 ONE TLA FAULT, ENG 1 REV MINOR FAULT ECAM 메시지가 표시됨. 지상에서는 메시지가 다시 나타나지 않음.
narrative_raw: ON ENGINE SHUTDOWN AT GATE GOT: ENG 1 ONE TLA FAULT, ENG 1 REV MINOR FAULT ECAM MSGS GROUNDED - YES. PERFORMED TS 76-11-00-810-831-A & TS 78-31-00-810-A23-A.OPS CHECKS GOOD NO MSG ON GRD.

symptom_en: APU emergency shutdown occurred.
symptom_ko: APU 비상 셧다운 발생함.
narrative_raw: APU EMER SHUT DOWN,  GROUNDED - YES.  PERFORMED OPS CHECK IAW AMM 49-00-00 PB 501.  NO FAULTS NOTED.

symptom_en: Engine 2 thrust lever sticks in reverse when coming back to idle thrust.
symptom_ko: 2번 엔진 스러스트 레버가 아이들 추력으로 복귀할 때 리버스에 걸림.
narrative_raw: ENGINE 2 THRUST LEVER STICKS IN REVERSE WHEN COMING BACK TO IDLE THRUST GROUNDED - YES. PERFORMED PFR CHECK NO FAULTS NOTED OPERATIONAL CHECK IAW 78-31-00-710-042-A PERFORMED T/R TEST THRU CFDS IAW 78-00-00-810 NO FAULTS NOTED PERFORMED GENERAL VISUAL #2 ENG

symptom_en: A piece of metal separated from the inner cowl exhaust on No. 1 engine.
symptom_ko: 1번 엔진 내부 카울 배기부에서 금속 조각이 분리됨.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: NR 1 ENGINE HAD A PIECE OF METAL SEPARATED FROM THE INNER COWL EXHAUST. MAINTENANCE REPLACED NR 1 ENGINE EXHAUST NOZZLE PER AMM 78-11-11-000-010-A AND 78-11-11-400-010-A. MAINTENANCE ALSO PERFORMED SATISFACTORY OPERATIONAL CHECK.

symptom_en: During descent, flight attendants and passengers reported a burning plastic smell. Some reported sore eyes and headache.
symptom_ko: 하강 중 승무원과 승객이 타는 플라스틱 냄새를 느낌. 눈 따가움과 두통을 호소함.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: PILOT REPORTS ON DESCENT FLIGHT ATTENDANTS AND PASSENGERS HAD SMELL OF BURNING, PLASTIC. COMPLAINED OF SORE EYES AND HEADACHE. MAINTENANCE REMOVED AND REPLACED APU STARTER MOTOR SEAL IAW AMM 49-42-51. OPS AND LEAK CHECK GOOD.

symptom_en: Right engine was slow to advance.
symptom_ko: 오른쪽 엔진 추력이 느리게 증가함.
narrative_raw: SHIP 3147 - ATO - LESS THAN 20KTS DUE TO FLIGHT CREW REPORT OF RIGHT ENGINE SLOW TO ADVANCE. CORRECTIVE ACTION: PERFORMED NO-GO ODI PREVENTION ATA 7185 PROCEDURE. C/W TSM 71-00-00-810-807-A AND A319 AMM 71-00-00-710-010-A. ENGINE ACCELS WITHIN LIMITS. REVIEWED PFR NO FADEC FAULTS.

symptom_en: Shortly after 80 knots on takeoff, ECAM message ENG1 COMPRESSOR VANE illuminated. The flight continued with auto-throttles off.
symptom_ko: 이륙 후 약 80노트에서 ECAM 메시지 ENG1 COMPRESSOR VANE가 표시됨. 자동스로틀을 끈 상태로 비행을 계속함.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: PILOT REPORTS SHORTLY AFTER 80K ON TAKE OFF, ECAM MSG ENG1 COMPRESSOR VANE ILLUMINATED. ECAM PROCEDURE AND FOLLOW UP ACTIONS COMPLETED. REST OF FLIGHT FLOWN WITH AUTO-THROTTLES OFF. MAINTENANCE ADJUSTED BLEED VALVE STOP MECHANISM IAW AMM 75-31-20-400-002. ACCOMPLISHED MOTORING FADEC CHECK CHANNELS A AND B CHECKS OK, NO FAULTS. FOUND CONNECTOR 4000KC-A LOOSE AND TIGHTENED. LUBED VSV IAW AMM 75-30-00.

symptom_en: Right engine oil quantity dropped suddenly and then fluctuated, while oil pressure stayed normal. The flight returned to departure and an engine change was declared.
symptom_ko: 오른쪽 엔진 오일 양이 갑자기 감소한 뒤 변동했고, 오일 압력은 정상으로 유지됨. 출발지로 회항했고 엔진 교체가 결정됨.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED,   FLIGHT RETURNED TO DEPARTURE ON ACCOUNT OF RIGHT ENGINE OIL QUANTITY DROPPING. EMERGENCY WAS DECLARED BY ATC. PILOT REPORTED RT ENGINE SUDDENLY LOST OIL QUANTITY FROM 19 TO 5, GRADUAL LOSS FROM 5 TO 2.5 THEN BACK TO 9.0, OIL PRESSURE THROUGHOUT WAS NORMAL.  MAINTENANCE TROUBLESHOT AND AN ENGINE CHANGE WAS DECLARED.  MAINTENANCE REMOVED AND REPLACED THE RT ENGINE IAW CARDS 26L40071004 AND 26L0007101.

symptom_en: ENG 2 IGN A fault occurred.
symptom_ko: ENG 2 IGN A 고장 발생함.
narrative_raw: ETOPS SIGNIFICANT SYSTEM - BTB - ENG 2 IGN A FAULT. PERFORMED OPS TEST OF THE EIU PER AMM 73-25-34, AND PERFORMED OPERATIONAL TEST OF IGNITION SYSTEM PER AMM 74-00-00. NO DEFECTS NOTED OPS TEST OK. OK FOR SERVICE.

symptom_en: After landing, ENG 1 oil chip detector fault was reported.
symptom_ko: 착륙 후 1번 엔진 오일 칩 디텍터 고장이 보고됨.
narrative_raw: ETOPS / AFTER LANDING ENG 1 OIL CHIP DETECTOR FAULT. PERFORMED TSM 79-00-00281-802-A. FOR INSP OF MAGNETIC CHIP COLLECTORS FOR OIL CONTAMINATION. FOUND DEBRIS NOT MORE THAN 25% OF PROBE TIP PERIMETER. PER TSM CLEAN CHIP COLLECTORS AND RETURNED A/C FOR SERVICE.

symptom_en: Engine 2 failed with compressor stall and EGT overtemperature about 5 minutes after takeoff. The flight returned and landed without further incident.
symptom_ko: 이륙 약 5분 후 2번 엔진 고장과 압축기 스톨, EGT 과온이 발생함. 항공기는 회항하여 추가 이상 없이 착륙함.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: AIRCRAFT RETURNED TO CLT DUE TO THE #2 ENGINE FAILURE / COMPRESSOR STALL AND EGT OVER TEMPERATURE  5 MINUTES AFTER TAKE OFF.  AN EMERGENCY WAS DECLARED AND THE AIRCRAFT LANDED WITHOUT FURTHER INCIDENT.   REMOVED AND REPLACED #2 ENGINE ASSY IAW J/C 26L40071004 DUE TO 7TH STAGE BLADE FAILURE.

symptom_en: An electrical fire occurred during APU start and the APU fire bottle was discharged.
symptom_ko: APU 시동 중 전기 화재가 발생하여 APU 소화병이 방출됨.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: DUE TO ELECTRICAL FIRE ON APU START DISCHARGED APU FIRE BOTTLE. REMOVED AND REPLACED APU FIRE EXTINGUISHING BOTTLE (11WF) IAW AMM 26-22-41-0401. OPS TEST NORMAL.  ALSO INSPECTED APU AND APU COMPARTMENT IAW AMM 49-00-00-200-001-A.  NO DEFECTS NOTED.

symptom_en: During engine run confidence check, a continuous fuel leak was observed from the drain mast when #1 engine was brought to power. It did not leak at idle.
symptom_ko: 엔진 운전 확인 점검 중 #1 엔진을 가동하면 드레인 마스트에서 연료 누설이 지속적으로 발생했고, 아이들에서는 누설이 없었음.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT IN BAST VISIT: MAINTENANCE REPORTS WHILE PERFORMING CONFIDENCE CHECK OF #1 ENGINE FIRE LOOPS WITH ENGINE RUNNING, OBSERVED CONTINUOUS FUEL LEAK COMING FROM DRAIN MAST WHEN ENGINE WAS TAKEN TO POWER, DID NOT LEAK AT IDLE. MAINTENANCEREMOVED AND REPLACED #1 ENG FUEL PUMP ASSY IAW AMM 73-11-10-400-003-A6. ACC'D SAT FADEC TEST, IDLE, AND 80% N1 RUN FOR 5 MINUTES. NO LEAKS

symptom_en: Slow speed rejected takeoff due to #2 engine hot air leak.
symptom_ko: 저속 이륙 중단을 #2 엔진 고온 공기 누설 때문에 수행함.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: SLOW SPEED REJECTED T/O FOR #2 ENGINE HOT AIR LEAK. REMOVED AND REPLACED FAN CASE CHANNEL THERMOCOUPLE NO.2 ENG. IAW AMM 77-22-11.

symptom_en: During descent through 14,000 feet, a fume smell was reported by cabin and cockpit crew. The odor was still present when parked at the gate.
symptom_ko: 14,000피트 하강 중 객실 승무원과 조종실 승무원이 연기/냄새를 보고함. 게이트 주기 후에도 냄새가 남아 있었음.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: PILOT REPORTS ON DESCENT THRU 14000, FUME SMELL REPORTED BY CABIN AND COCKPIT CREW ODOR STILL PRESENT WHEN PARKED AT GATE. MAINTENANCE ACCOMPLISHED S.O.F. TROUBLESHOOTING CARDS 26L00021001, 26L00021002 AND ECS DECONTAMINATION CARD 26L00021004. REPLACED ORING PACKING ON APU SCAVENGE OIL TUBE IAW AMM 49-91-53. NO LEAKS AND NO ODORS.

symptom_en: A crack was found on the inboard side of the combustion section plate at about the 6 o'clock position on engine 1.
symptom_ko: 1번 엔진 연소부 플레이트 인보드 쪽 약 6시 방향에 균열이 확인됨.
narrative_raw: CRACK COMBUSTION SECTION PLATE INBOARD SIDE LOC AT 6 OCLOCK APROX ON ENGINE 1. REPAIRED AND INSTALLED COMBUSTION SECTION PLATE INBOARD SIDE LOC AT 6 OCLOCK APROX ON ENGINE 1 AS PER ERA 564620-14MA REV. ORIGINAL AND CFM56-5A ESM 71-00-01-440-024-0.

symptom_en: After engine shutdown at the gate, the EICAS message for the No. 1 engine fuel filter clog illuminated.
symptom_ko: 게이트에서 엔진 셧다운 후 1번 엔진 연료 필터 막힘 EICAS 메시지가 표시됨.
narrative_raw: AFTER ENGINE SHUTDOWN AT THE GATE, AN EICAS MEESSAGE FOR THE NR 1 ENGINE FUEL FILTER CLOG ILLUMINATED.  THE AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED.  MAINTENANCE REMOVED AND REPLACED THE DIFFERENTIAL PRESSURE SWITCH IAW AMM 73-34-15. OPS TESTED GOOD.

symptom_en: ECAM F/CTL FLAPS LOCKED displayed when flaps were selected to 2. Flight control flaps indication was abnormal.
symptom_ko: 플랩을 2로 선택했을 때 ECAM F/CTL FLAPS LOCKED가 표시됨. 플라이트 컨트롤 플랩 표시가 비정상적이었음.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: PILOT REPORTS ECAM- F/CTL FLAPS LOCKED WHEN FLAPS EXTENDED TO 2. MAINTENANCE ACCOMPLISHED TROUBLESHOT TSM 27-51-00-810-818A. FOUND X DIMENSION OF SENSOR 38CV OUT OF RANGE. ADJUSTED SENSOR TO PROPER X DIMENSION IAW AMM 27-51-44-400-002A AND ACCOMPLISHED OPS TEST OF FLAPS IAW AMM 27-54-00-710-001A. NO FAULTS NOTED. OPS CHECK OF FLAPS NOW NORMAL.

symptom_en: ECAM F/CTL FLAPS FAULT displayed on approach.
symptom_ko: 접근 중 ECAM F/CTL FLAPS FAULT가 표시됨.
narrative_raw: EMERGENCY DECLARED) ON APPROACH RECEIVED ECAM F/CTL FLAPS FAULT / REPLACED FLAP-PCU"

symptom_en: Speed brakes were flashing as if they were out, then the aircraft showed a left bank indication during climb. The right aileron was showing neutral.
symptom_ko: 이륙 후 스피드 브레이크가 나온 것처럼 깜박였고, 상승 중 좌측 뱅크가 표시됨. 오른쪽 에일러론은 중립으로 보였음.
narrative_raw: ON TAKE OFF ROLL THE AIRCRAFT SWERVED A BIT.  WE NOTICED ON CLIMB OUT WE NOTICED THE SPEED BRAKES WERE FLASHING AS IF THEY WERE OUT.  THE SPEED BRAKES "AMBER" WENT AWAY.  HOWEVER, DURING THE CLIMB IT WAS SHOWING A BANK TO THE LEFT.  THE RIGHT AILERON WAS SHOWING NEUTRAL.-REF TSM 27-10-00-810-842-A.  ACCOMPLISHED OPERATIONS TEST OF SIDE STICK ASSEMBLY, IAW AMM 27-96-00, ACCOMPLISHED INTEGRITY TEST OF FLIGHT CONTROL SYSTEM, IAW AMM 27-93-00.  OPERATIONS CHECK GOOD.  CONTINUED TROUBLESHOOTING, IAW TSM 27-10-00-810-842-A FURTHER TROUBLESHOOTING REQUIRED.

symptom_en: Stab trim was binding.
symptom_ko: 수평안정판 트림이 걸리는 증상이 있었음.
narrative_raw: STAB TRIM BINDING // PERFORMED OPERATIONAL TEST OF LOGISTICS ACTUATION ELAC 1&2 & SEC STANDBY POWER SUPPLY & ABILITY OF SEC 1&2 TO ACHIEVE PITCH CTL & ABILITY OF SIDE STICK PRIORITY FUNCTION, OPS CHECKS GOOD. A/C OK FOR SERVICE PER E/C 279000-05-1, WO# 394380 AMM 27-96-00-710-018-A.

symptom_en: On takeoff thrust application, FLIGHT CONTROL SPOILER 1 AND 2 FAULT was displayed. Takeoff was aborted.
symptom_ko: 이륙 추력 증가 시 FLIGHT CONTROL SPOILER 1 AND 2 FAULT가 표시됨. 이륙이 중단됨.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT GROUNDED, ABORTED TAKE-OFF.  WHEN ADVANCING THRUST AT TAKE-OFF, FLIGHT CONTROL SPOILER 1 AND 2 FAULT.  REMOVED AND REPLACED SEC (SPOILER ELEVATOR COMPUTER) 3 PER TSM 27-94-00 AND AMM 27-94-34, OPERATIONAL CHECK OKAY.

symptom_en: Slats were jammed on approach and the recycle did not work. An emergency was declared and the aircraft landed.
symptom_ko: 접근 중 슬랫이 걸려 있었고 재순환이 되지 않았음. 비상선언 후 착륙함.
narrative_raw: FLT 81, JFK-RNO. SLATS JAMMED AT ON APPROACH RECYCLE DID NOT WORK. DECLARED EMERGENCY FOLLOWED QRH AND LANDED. PERFORMED TSM 27-81-00-810-810-A FOUND NR 4 ACTUATOR TRIPPED ON THE LEFT HAND SIDE. RESET ACTUATOR AND LUBED SLAT SYSTEM AND PERFORMED OPS CHECK PER AMM 27-84-00-710-001-. NO FAULTS NOTED AC OK FOR SERVICE.

symptom_en: F/CTL SPLR FAULT message displayed, with spoiler number 3 showing on both wings.
symptom_ko: F/CTL SPLR FAULT 메시지가 표시됐고, 양쪽 날개에 3번 스포일러가 표시됨.
narrative_raw: F/CTL SPLR FAULT MESSNUMBER 3 SPOILER SHOWINUP ON BOTH WINGSFA V ERIFY DOWN T/S PER TSM TASK 27-60-00-810-830-A. REMOVED AND REPLACED SEC1 PER AMM 27-94-34. NO FAULTS FOUND. AIRCRAFT BACK TO SERVICE. ROTABLE PARTS CHANGE WAS INDICATED - TT # 1059407  SN OFF 5139 SEE L/P 4628030 ADD EMP:U353205

symptom_en: Strong vibration was felt in the rudder pedals during descent and after gear extension. The vibration affected both left and right pedals.
symptom_ko: 강하 중과 착륙장치 내린 후 러더 페달에 심한 진동이 느껴짐. 좌우 페달 모두 영향을 받았음.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: STRONG VIBRATION IN RUDDER PEDALS 2000' AGL BEFORE GEAR EXTENSION TO 500' AGL GEAR DOWN VIBRATION CONTINUED 20 SECONDS AFTER AUTOPILOT OFF. PEDALS LEFT AND RIGHT BOTH SIDES CAPT & FO MOVING 3/8" DISPLACEMENT. PUSHING ON BOTH PEDALS WOULD NOT STOP PEDALS FROM JUMPING AROUND, WENT AWAY AT 500' AGL.   MAINTENANCE REPLACED THE ARTIFICIAL FEEL AND TRIM UNIT IAW AMM 27-23-41-4 00-001-A AND PERFORMED OPERATIONAL TEST OF THE ARTIFICAL FEEL AND TRIM UNIT IAW AMM 27-23-00-710-001-A AND 27-23-00-710-001-A-01 AND PERFORMED OPERATIONAL TEST OF THE RUDDER TRIM ACTUATION IAW AMM 27-22-00-710-002-A AND TESTS ARE OK.

symptom_en: F/CTL AIL SERVO FAULT was displayed. The left aileron blue system box was amber on the F/CTL page.
symptom_ko: F/CTL AIL SERVO FAULT가 표시됨. F/CTL 페이지에서 왼쪽 에일러론 blue system box가 amber로 표시됨.
narrative_raw: FLT 799, FLL-HAV.  RETURNED TO FIELD.  F/CTL AIL SERVO FAULT.  L AIL BLUE SYSTEM BOXED AMBER ON F/CTL PAGE, REF TSM 27-93-34.  R & R NR 1 ELAC, IAW AMM 27-93-34.  OPERATIONS CHECKS OK.

symptom_en: ECAM FLIGHT CONTROL FLAPS FAULT message displayed during descent.
symptom_ko: 강하 중 ECAM FLIGHT CONTROL FLAPS FAULT 메시지가 표시됨.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED.  ON DESCENT INTO AUS, AN EMERGENCY WAS DECLARED DUE TO A FLIGHT CONTROL FLAPS FAULT MESSAGE.  THE AIRCRAFT LANDED SAFELY WITHOUT FURTHER INCIDENT.  MAINTENANCE FOUND THE LEFT WING NR 1 FLAP ACTUATOR TORQUE LIMITER TRIPPED AND REPLACED THE FLAP ACTUATOR, PER AMM 27-54-49.

symptom_en: F/CTL FLAPS FAULT ECAM warning was displayed during flight after earlier F/CTL system faults.
symptom_ko: 이전 F/CTL 시스템 고장 이후 비행 중 F/CTL FLAPS FAULT ECAM 경고가 표시됨.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT HAD F/CTL SYS 2 FAULT DEFERRED ON DEC-04, THEN ON THE SAME DAY ON FLIGHT AV310 SAL-MIA SYSTEM 1 FAILS AND AIRCRAFT EMIT THE F/CTL FLAPS FAULT ECAM WARNING, WHICH LEADS THE CREW TO DECLARE EMERGENCY FOR LANDING.  ONCE THE AIRCRAFT WAS ON GROUND TSM 27-81-00-810-804-A AND 27-51-00-810-836-A WERE FOLLOWED.  SFCC 2 WAS REPLACED, TEST TO BOTH SFCC WERE OK AND RESTRICTED CONDITION F/CTLS FLAPS FAULT WAS CORRECTED.  AIRCRAFT RETURNED TO SAL WERE SFCC 1 WAS REPLACED TO ELIMINATE THE POSSIBLITIES TO THE FAULT OCCURS AGAIN.

symptom_en: ECAM F/CTL FLAPS FAULT message displayed during descent.
symptom_ko: 강하 중 ECAM F/CTL FLAPS FAULT 메시지가 표시됨.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: PILOT DECLARED EMERGENCY ON DECENT DUE TO ECAM MSG F/CTL FLAPS FAULT. MAINTENANCE ADJUSTED INTERCONNECTING STRUT PROX SWITCH IAW AMM 27-51-15. FLAP SYSTEM OPS CHEKS NORM.

symptom_en: Flaps were locked. L/H APPU synchro angles were out of limits and debris was found in the L/H APPU inspection window.
symptom_ko: 플랩이 잠겨 있었음. 왼쪽 APPU 동기각이 한계를 벗어났고 왼쪽 APPU 점검창에 이물질이 있었음.
narrative_raw: F LOCKED FLAP-PERFORMED TROUBLE SHOOTING PER TSM 27-51-00-810-819-A FOUND L/H APPU SYNCHRO ANGLES IN EXCESS OF 5.2 PERFORMED VISUAL INSP OF TRANSMISSION ASSEMBLY PER AMM 27-54-00-200-001-A NO DEFECTS NOTED FOUND L/H APPU INSPECTION WINDOW FILLED WITH DEBRIS R/R L/H APPU PER AMM 27-51-18 OPS CHECK GOOD SYNCRO ANGLES WITING LIMITS WTB RESET PER AMM 27-50-00

symptom_en: The F/O side stick had no response for about half of right roll input. Left roll was normal.
symptom_ko: 부조종사 사이드스틱이 우롤 입력의 절반 정도에서 반응이 없었음. 좌롤은 정상적이었음.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT NOT GROUNDED: PILOT REPORTS INFLIGHT F/O SIDE STICK WHEN ROLLING TO THE RIGHT, THERE IS NO RESPONSE FOR 1/2 OF SIDE STICK  MOVEMENT, LEFT ROLL IS NORMAL. MAINTENANCE ACCOMPLISHED POST FLIGHT REPORT, NO FAULTS MESSAGES OR WARNINGS. ACCOMPLISHED OPERATIONAL CHECK OF CAPT/FO SIDE STICK ASSEMBLY IAW AMM 29-92-41, NO FAULTS TEST PASSED.

symptom_en: Severe vibration was felt in the rear of the aircraft during descent, including the galley and floor.
symptom_ko: 강하 중 항공기 후방, 갤리와 바닥에서 심한 진동이 느껴짐.
narrative_raw: FLT 119, ALB-MCO. ON DESCENT AT APPX. 16' K NOTICED VIBRATION. FA IN AFT CALLED AND ADVISE DRASTIC VIB IN REAR OF A/C. GALLEY AND FLOOR VIB; REF. T/S FOUND RH ELEV SERV CONTROL FIN 34CE2 OSCILLATING R & R RH ELEV SERVO CONTROL FIN 34CE2.

symptom_en: ECAM SLATS FAULT was displayed on approach. The left outboard slat actuator showed a torque limiter indicator spring broken.
symptom_ko: 접근 중 ECAM SLATS FAULT가 표시됨. 왼쪽 외측 슬랫 액추에이터의 토크 리미터 표시 스프링이 파손되어 있었음.
narrative_raw: EMERGENCY ON APPROACH.  SLATS FAULT DISPLAYED ON UPPER ECAM SCREEN.  - F-CTL FLAPS WENT TO 3 SLATS O.  ACCOMPLISHED OPERATIONAL TEST OF SLAT SYSTEM, PER AMM 27-84-00-710-001-A.  AFTER REPLACEMENT OF NR 1 LT OUTBOARD SLAT ACTUATOR.  LT OUTBOARD SLAT ACTUATOR TYPE ''A'' HAS TORQUE LIMITER INDICATOR SPRING BROKEN.  PERFORMED OPERATIONAL CHECK, OPERATIONS CHECKED GOOD, REF MM27-84-00-710-A.

symptom_en: During descent, the aircraft rolled left and right uncommanded three times. The F/CTL SYS page showed aileron movement and symmetrical speedbrake extension.
symptom_ko: 강하 중 항공기가 명령 없이 좌우로 세 번 롤함. F/CTL SYS 페이지에 에일러론 움직임과 대칭적인 스피드브레이크 전개가 표시됨.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT NOT GROUNDED: PILOT REPORTS DURING DESCENT AT IDLE THRUST AND FLAPS TWO, AC ROLLED LEFT AND RIGHT UNCOMMANDED, ROLL  RECOVERED WHEN SPEED BRAKES WERE MOVED FROM HALF TO FULL. HAPPENED THREE TIMES. F/CTL SYS PAGE  SHOWED AILERON MOVEMENT AND SYMETRICAL SPEEDBRAKE EXTENTION. AUTOPILOT WAS ENGAGED VERY SIMILAR TO WAKE TURBULANCE ENCOUNTER BUT NO AC NEARBY. MAINTENANCE PERFORMED TSM TASKS 27-10-00-810-836-A AND 27-60-00-810-851-A, ALL CHECKS NORMAL, NO FAULTS NOTED. OK FOR SERVICE.

symptom_en: The rudder kicked to the right with no pedal input when the Y hydraulic system was powered.
symptom_ko: Y 유압계통에 전원이 들어가면 페달 입력 없이 러더가 오른쪽으로 움직였음.
narrative_raw: "FT # 391, BOS-TPA. DURING PHASE 2 COCKPIT JOB CARD A320-27-24-00-710-002 OPS TEST OF RUDDER SERVOCTL WITH INDIVIDUAL HYD SYSTEM; FOUND RUDDER WOULD KICK OVER TO THE RIGHT WITH OUT PEDAL INPUT ON ""Y"" HYD SYSTEM PWR; FOUND ""Y"" SYSTEM SERVOCONTROL (3025GM) INPUT CONTROL LEVER DETACHED FROM SERVOCONTROL   REMOVED AND REPLACED SERVOCONTROL (3025GM) IAW AMM 27-24-51  OPS & L/CKD GOOD ALL RIG PINS REMOVED."

symptom_en: ECAM F/CTL AIL SERVO FAULT, then ECAM F/CTL ELAC 2 FAULT, displayed during takeoff roll before 70 knots. The takeoff was rejected.
symptom_ko: 이륙 활주 중 70노트 이전에 ECAM F/CTL AIL SERVO FAULT가 표시됐고 이어서 ECAM F/CTL ELAC 2 FAULT가 표시됨. 이륙을 중단함.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: PILOT REPORTS ON TAKE OFF ROLL BEFORE 70 KTS  ECAM F/CTL AIL  SERVO FAULT. REJECTED TAKE OFF AFTER CLEARING RUNWAY ECAM F/CTL ELAC 2 FAULT. MAINTENANCE REMOVED AND REPLACED ELAC 2 IAW AMM 27-93-34. PERFORMED REACTIVATION OF THE AILERON SERVO CONTROL IAW AMM 27-14-00-440-001-A. PERFORMED OPERATIONAL TEST OF ELAC 2 IAW AMM 22-97-00-710-001-A AND LAND CAT III CAPABILITY TEST 22-97-00-710-001-A. AIRCRAFT REMAINS CAT III DUAL.

symptom_en: On approach, selecting flaps 2 caused an ECAM flap fault. The slats deployed but the flaps did not, and the fault cleared after cycling.
symptom_ko: 접근 중 플랩 2 선택 시 ECAM flap fault가 발생함. 슬랫은 전개됐지만 플랩은 전개되지 않았고, 사이클링 후 정상으로 돌아왔음.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: PILOT REPORTS ON APPROACH TO 22R WITH GUSTY WINDS (310 21 GUSTS 28) WHEN SELECTING FLAPS 2@ 180KTS ECAM FOR FLAP FAULT (SLATS DEPLOYED BUT FLAPS DID NOT). NORMAL AFTER CYCLING. MAINTENANCE TROUBLESHOT IAW TSM 27-51-00-810-810-A. FOUND L/H WING #1 TORQUE LIMITER TRIPPED AND TRACK ACTUATOR CONTAMINATED W/ WATER. REMOVED AND REPLACED #1 TRACK ACTUATOR IAW AMM 27-54-49. OPS CHECK GOOD.

symptom_en: Slats would not extend after the appropriate checklists were run. After landing, there was no slats reference indication.
symptom_ko: 슬랫이 적절한 체크리스트 수행 후에도 전개되지 않음. 착륙 후 슬랫 기준 표시가 없음.
narrative_raw: FLT 123, JFK-LAX. F/CTL SLATS FAULT SLATS WOULD NOT EXTEND AFTER RUNNING APPROPRIATE CHECKLISTS LANDED F3 NO SLATS REF + 25; R & R BOTH SFCC #1 AND #2 FOR PRECAUTIONARY. REF LOG PAGE 2509782 LAND CAT I I I  TEST REQ PER AMM 27-51-34-400-001-A. REF ISI 27-51-00044 PARTS ARE 2 WAY INTERCHANGEABLE. PER TSM 27-81-00-810-810-A OPERATED F/CTL OPS CHECK NORMAL. SFCC1 LT APPU 0.1 FPPU 0.0 RT APPU 0.1. SFCC 2 LT APPU 0.1 FPPU 0.0 RT APPU 0.1. FOR THE SLATS OK. WITH IN RANGE. EXAMINE TORQUE LIMITERS NO TRIPPED TORQUE LIMITERS. MOVED SLATS NO INCORRECT NOISE COMING FROM WING TIP BRAKE. WING TIP BRAKE ARE EASY TO TURN. CHECKED 1&2 PCU HYDRAULIC MOTOR, HYDRAULIC MOTOR NR 1 AND NR 2 CHECKED NORMAL.

symptom_en: Stuck flap indication was reported and the aircraft was grounded. The left-hand flap interconnecting strut proximity sensor was involved.
symptom_ko: 플랩 고착 표시가 보고되어 항공기가 결항됨. 좌측 플랩 인터커넥팅 스트럿 근접 센서 관련 이상이 있었음.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: CREW DECLARED AN EMERGENCY INTO LAX ON ACCOUNT OF STUCK FLAP INDICATION. MAINTENANCE REMOVED AND REPLACED L/H FLAP INTERCONNECTING STRUT PROXIMITY SENSOR 39CV IAW AMM 27-51-44. ACCOMPLISHED OPS TEST OF FLAP FAILURE DETECTION SENSORS IAW AMM 27-51-00. OPS CHECKED NORMAL.

symptom_en: Flaps locked alignment fault was reported and the aircraft was grounded. The right-hand flap interconnecting strut alignment was out of adjustment.
symptom_ko: 플랩 잠김 정렬 이상이 보고되어 항공기가 결항됨. 우측 플랩 인터커넥팅 스트럿 정렬이 맞지 않았음.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: PILOT REPORTS FLT/CTL- FLAPS LOCKED ALIGNMENT FAULT. EMERGENCY DECLARED. MAINTENANCE PERFORMED ADJUSTMENT OF R/H FLAP INTERCONNECTING STRUT. RIG AND OPS CHECK GOOD. RESET FLAP WTB SYSTEM, CHECKS OK IAW TSM 27-51-00-810-818-A.

symptom_en: With speed brake in use and flaps at 2, the aircraft rolled 5 to 10 degrees left/right unexpectedly. It happened twice and no ECAM message was displayed.
symptom_ko: 스피드 브레이크 사용 중 플랩 2 상태에서 항공기가 5~10도 정도 비의도적으로 기울어짐. 두 번 발생했고 ECAM 메시지는 표시되지 않음.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED.  WHEN SPEED BRAKE WAS USED & FLAPS 2, 180 KNOTS AIRCRAFT WENT INTO A 5-10 DEGREE BANK.  HAPPENED AT 9000 FEET AND AGAIN AT 4000 FEET.  NO ECAM MESSAGES DISPLAYED DUE TO A UNCOMMANDED ROLL INCIDENT. TROUBLESHOT, REF TSM 27-10-00-810-842-A, NO FAULTS.

symptom_en: Stab trim jumped and the autopilot kicked off repeatedly. Pitch fault indications remained even with the autopilot off.
symptom_ko: 스태빌라이저 트림이 갑자기 변하고 오토파일럿이 반복적으로 떨어짐. 오토파일럿을 꺼도 피치 고장 표시가 계속됨.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: PILOT DECLARED EMERGENCY ON ACCOUNT STAB TRIM ISSUES WITH AUTO-PILOT FAIL. STAB TRIM WOULD JUMP 8 UNITS A/C PITCH UP A/P WOULD KICK OFF RECOVERED TRIED A/P 2 SAME AFTER MULTIPLE FAILS A/P OFF STILL GOT FAULT UNTIL ELAC 1 AND ELAC 2 PITCH FAULT APPLIED ECAM PROC. AIRCRAFT LANDED OVERWEIGHT WITHOUT INCIDENT. MAINTENANCE REMOVED AND REPLACED ELAC 1 AND 2 IAW AMM 27-93-34. OPS CHECK GOOD IAW AMM 27-93-00. (SEE SDR # AALA201906049041)

symptom_en: Oil or musty smell was reported in the cockpit and aft cabin during descent. The smell was also strong in the cockpit on the ground with APU bleed air on.
symptom_ko: 하강 중 조종실과 후방 객실에서 기름 냄새 또는 곰팡이 냄새가 남. 지상에서 APU 블리드 에어 사용 시에도 조종실에서 냄새가 강하게 남.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: CREW REPORTS OIL/MUSTY SMELL ON DECENT IN COCKPIT AND AFT CABIN. ALSO PRONOUNCED ON THE GROUND IN THE COCKPIT WHEN ON APU BLEED AIR. MAINTENANCE FOUND THE PTU LEAKING. REMOVED AND REPLACED THE PTU IAW AMM 29-23-41. OPS AND LEAK CHECK GOOD.

symptom_en: Loss of nose wheel steering was reported on arrival, with loss of full steering at the same time.
symptom_ko: 도착 시 노즈 휠 조향 상실이 보고되었고 동시에 완전 조향도 상실됨.
narrative_raw: (CAN) CREW REPORT LOSS NOSE WHEEL STEERING ON ARRIVAL, LOSS OF FULL STEERING SIMULTANEOUSLY. EXITED RUNWAY TO RAMP WITH DIRECTIONAL BRAKING/STEERING.  RESOLUTION SERVO-CONTROL MODULE 6GC REPLACED IAW AMM 32-51-51, NLG ELECTRICAL HARNESS 2M REPLACED IAW AMM 32-21-43. SERVICEABLE.

symptom_en: Green hydraulic quantity was low and maintenance found hydraulic fluid in the right wing fuel tanks. A leak was also found at the nose gear closure line.
symptom_ko: 그린 유압량이 낮았고 정비 중 우측 날개 연료 탱크에서 유압유가 발견됨. 노즈 기어 클로저 라인에서도 누설이 확인됨.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: MAINTENANCE FOUND HYD FLUID IN FUEL RT WING TANKS WHILE TROUBLESHOOTING GREEN HYD LOW QYT WITH 4 SERVICES IN TWO DAYS, FOUND NO EXTERNAL HYD LEAKS. PERFORMED LEAK CHECK OF GREEN SYSTEM HYDRAULIC LINES IN R/H WING SURGE TANK. NO LEAKS FOUND. RT WING FUEL SAMPLE PRODUCED TRACE AMOUNTS OF WATER ONLY. MAINTENANCE FOUND NOSE GEAR CLOSURE LINE LEAKING. REMOVED AND REPLACED CONTAMINATED INSULATION AND REPLACED HYD LINE AND RE-INSTALLED ALL FWD CARGO PANELS AND FLOORING OPS LEAK CHECKS GOOD IAW AMM'S 25-54-11, 32-31-00 AARD 21-21-00, EA 299349.

symptom_en: In flight at cruise, HYD G RSVR LO LVL message was reported. Manual gear extension was required for landing.
symptom_ko: 순항 중 HYD G RSVR LO LVL 메시지가 보고됨. 착륙을 위해 수동 착륙장치 전개가 필요했음.
narrative_raw: DISCREPANCY: REFERENCE LOG PAGE LP1149776 ITEM 1, IN FLIGHT AT CRUISE FL360, "HYD G RSVR LO LVL". PERFORMED MANUAL GEAR EXTENSION FOR LANDING. CORRECTIVE ACTION: REPLACED THE DRAIN VALVE, GREEN HYDRAULIC RESEVOIR, REFERENCE AMM 29-11-41-000-004-A AND 29-11-41-400-004-A. LEAK CHECKED OK. TORQUE WRENCH S/N F9TAB3947C DUE 10/19. RE-SET THE GRAVITY GEAR EXTENSION REFERENCE AMM 32-33-00-710-001-A./END/

symptom_en: Number 3 tire blew on landing, with BRAKES SYS 1 FAULT and BRAKES AUTO BRK FAULT ECAM warning displayed.
symptom_ko: 착륙 시 3번 타이어가 파손되었고 BRAKES SYS 1 FAULT, BRAKES AUTO BRK FAULT ECAM 경고가 표시됨.
narrative_raw: NR 3 TIRE BLOWN ON LANDING WITH BRAKES SYS 1 FAULT / BRAKES AUTO BRK FAULT ECAM WARNING. FIRE EMERGENCY WAS AT THE SCENE WITH LOCAL MAINTENANCE, AIRCRAFT TOWED TO THE GATE.   FOUND CONNECTOR TO # 3 WHEEL NORMAL BRAKE SERVO VALVE (16GG) OFF THE VALVE AND DANGLING ON THE RT MLG LEG. RE-CONNECTED CONNECTOR, RESET BSCU, REPLACED #3 AND #4 WHEEL ASSY. TESTED ANTI-SKID SYSTEM NORMAL.

symptom_en: LANDING GEAR DOORS NOT CLOSED ECAM message appeared after takeoff from DFW.
symptom_ko: DFW 이륙 후 LANDING GEAR DOORS NOT CLOSED ECAM 메시지가 표시됨.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT NOT GROUNDED. LANDING GEAR DOORS NOT CLOSED ECAM MESSAGE AFTER TAKE-OFF FROM DFW. CYCLED GEAR LEVER PER PROCEDURE. DOORS SUBSEQUENTLY CLOSED. REPLACED LANDING GEAR SAFETY VALVE PER AMM 32-31-17-400-001-A (AALA202006179018). ALSO REPLACED RELAY 53AG PER AMM 32-30-00. (AALA202006179017). A SATISFACTORY OPERATIONAL CHECK WAS ACCOMPLISHED.

symptom_en: ENG 1 G pump low pressure was reported. The green hydraulic system was lost due to a damaged flexible hose.
symptom_ko: ENG 1 G 펌프 저압이 보고됨. 손상된 플렉시블 호스로 인해 그린 유압 계통이 완전히 소실됨.
narrative_raw: HYD ENG 1 G PUMP LOW PRESSURE-FOUND LINE ( FLEXIBLE HOSE 2766GM ) DAMAGED, LEADING TO DRAINING G SYS COMPLETLY CAUSING FAULT. R/R FLEXIBLE HOSE LINE 2766GM. OPS CHECK LEAK CHECK GOOD. NO FAULTS PRESENT. REF AMM 32-31-39; 29-00-00; 71-00-00; TSM 29-11-00-810-055B. A/C OK FOR SVC

symptom_en: A yellow hydraulic reservoir low/low pressure ECAM was received near top of descent. A small amount of residual fluid was found on one tire.
symptom_ko: 하강 상단 부근에서 노란 유압 리저버 저/저압 ECAM이 발생함. 한쪽 타이어에서 소량의 잔류 유체가 발견됨.
narrative_raw: (CAN) NEAR TOP OF DESCENT, FLIGHT EXPERIENCED A YELLOW HYDRAULIC RESERVOIR LOW/LO PRESSURE ECAM. CHECK LIST WAS CARRIED OUT AND A PAN PAN WAS DECLARED WITH ATC. A LANDING WAS CARRIED OUT WITH AIRCRAFT COMING TO A FULL STOP AND EMERGENCY VEHICLES CONDUCTING AN INSPECTION. ONLY A SMALL AMOUNT OF RESIDUAL FLUID WAS FOUND ON ONE OF THE TIRES. THE AIRCRAFT TAXIED TO THE GATE UNDER ITS OWN POWER.   RESOLUTION REMOVED AND REPLACED MANIFOLD ASSY.IAW AMM 29-32-03PB401.OPS AND LEAK CHECK GOOD. (TC# 20190501006)

symptom_en: After takeoff, an L/G unlock message appeared, followed by a flap locked message, then green system overheat, yellow system overheat, and finally gear gravity extend.
symptom_ko: 이륙 후 착륙장치 잠금 해제 메시지, 플랩 잠김 메시지, 그린 계통 과열, 옐로우 계통 과열이 순서대로 발생한 뒤 착륙장치가 중력 전개됨.
narrative_raw: AFTER T/O CREW HAD L/G UNLOCK MSG THEN FLAP LOCKED MSG FOLLOWED BY GREEN SYS OVERHEAT THEN HAD YELLOW SYS OVERHEAT AND FINALLY G EAR GRAVITY EXTEND.

symptom_en: During cruise, an ARM code for a nose wheel steering indication problem was received.
symptom_ko: 순항 중 노즈 휠 조향 표시 이상에 대한 ARM 코드가 발생함.
narrative_raw: DURING CRUISE, RECEIVED AN ARM CODE FOR NOSE WHEEL STEERING INDICATION PROBLEM.  CONTINUED TO DESTINATION, AN EMERGENCY WAS DECLARED AND LANDED WITHOUT INCIDENT.  REMOVED AND REPLACED THE NOSE WHEEL STEERING MODULE. OPS CHECKED GOOD IAW AMM 32-51-51.

symptom_en: The number 3 MLG brake was damaged due to tie bolt failure.
symptom_ko: 3번 주착륙장치 브레이크가 타이 볼트 파손으로 손상됨.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: MAINTENANCE REPORTS THE NR 3 MLG BRAKE DAMAGED DUE TO TIE BOLT FAILURE. REMOVED AND REPLACED THE NR 3 WHEEL AND TIRE ASSEMBLY IAW AMM 32-41-11-400-006-A.

symptom_en: The left gear upper bearing blanking plug was missing on arrival.
symptom_ko: 도착 시 좌측 기어 상부 베어링 블랭킹 플러그가 없어짐.
narrative_raw: LEFT GEAR UPPER BEARING BLANKING PLUG MISSING ON ARRIVAL. REMOVED SPEED TAPE ERA 575079 AS A TEMPORARY REPAIR AND REPLACED WITH LEFT GEAR UPPER BEARING BLANKING PLUG STK NR 00-3200-3-0198 PER ERA 575079 PERMANENT REPAIR.

symptom_en: After pushback with one engine running, parking brake was on with an ECAM message displayed and the aircraft rolled forward. Brake pressures read zero on the triple indicator, then returned to normal after engine shutdown.
symptom_ko: 푸시백 후 엔진 1개가 가동 중일 때 주차브레이크가 걸려 있었고 ECAM 메시지가 표시된 상태에서 항공기가 앞으로 굴러감. 트리플 인디케이터의 브레이크 압력이 0으로 표시되다가 엔진 정지 후 정상으로 돌아옴.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT GROUNDED - AFTER PUSHBACK, WITH ONE ENGINE RUNNING, PARKING BRAKE WAS ON WITH ECAM MESSAGE DISPLAYED. AIRCRAFT ROLLED FORWARD, BRAKE PRESSURES READ ZERO ON TRIPLE INDICATOR. ONCE ENGINE WAS SHUT DOWN, TRIPLE INDICATOR RETURNED TO NORMAL.  SERVICED PARKING BRAKE ACCUMULATOR PER AMM 32-44-11.  [REPEAT DISCREPANCY] PRIOR TO PUSHBACK, BRAKE ACCUMULATOR WENT TO ZERO BRAKE PRESSURE.  REMOVED AND REPLACED BRAKE PRESSURE RELIEF VALVE PER AMM 32-44-15, OPERATIONAL CHECK GOOD, NO LEAKS NOTED.

symptom_en: During landing rollout between 70 knots and 10 knots, braking was intermittently grabbing.
symptom_ko: 착륙 활주 중 70노트에서 10노트 구간에서 제동이 간헐적으로 잡아당기는 증상이 있었음.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT NOT GROUNDED: NON NORMAL BRAKING APPLICATION BETWEEN 70 KTS AND 10 KTS ON LANDING ROLLOUT HAD INTERMITTENT GRABBING. ACCOMPLISHED BSCU #1 AND 2 BRAKE TEST, NO FAULTS DETECTED. INSPECTECTED BRAKE VISUALLY AND CYCLE BRAKES, NO DEFECTS NOTED.

symptom_en: During gear retraction, the gear door did not open. After recycling the gear switch, the gear door closed.
symptom_ko: 착륙장치 수납 중 기어 도어가 열리지 않음. 기어 스위치를 재순환하자 기어 도어가 닫힘.
narrative_raw: AIRCRAFT WAS GROUNDED: DURING GEAR RETRACTION GEAR DOOR DID NOT OPEN. FOLLOWED ECAM RECYCLED LG GEAR SWITCH THEN GEAR DOOR CLOSED. REMOVED AND REPLACED GEAR SELECTOR VALVE IAW 32-31-34.

symptom_en: ENG 1 hydraulic pump failed after flap retraction.
symptom_ko: 1번 엔진 유압 펌프가 플랩 수납 후 고장남.
